reason: The cited lines show filesystem access based on a provided path: statSync checks the path, glob enumerates TypeScript files, and createSourceFile reads/parses files for analysis. That supports SECRET because host filesystem metadata and file contents can enter the tool/agent context. It also supports UNTRUSTED because the path and project files being enumerated/read may be attacker-controllable inputs. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution. They also do not show sending data to an attacker-readable destination or any network/public write sink; the migrateSingleFile call is opaque here and does not by itself establish a SINK.
